verdict.rationale: Kushki documents Apple Pay payments, Webpay Plus (a local Chilean payment method), and markets "multiple payment methods with one API," so it supports a wallet plus a local method through a single integration. Missing for 10: any evidence of Google Pay, BNPL, or explicit bank-redirect methods; detail showing these methods run through the same integration surface; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: Múltiples medios de pago con una API
